items.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Joe was in the band when we was touring together.

ctx.x: Have you had an opportunity to either sing on the same program with or privy to the personal sounds of Joe Williams?

Well of course. Joe was in the band when we was touring together. And of course we now live in the same town, in Vegas. Joe’s been living there quite a while. In fact the last time I saw him we did the tribute for Peggy Lee. And Joe, again, is like what I call the master blues singer. He is the master. The most, not predictable, but really predictable. You almost know where he’s going musically you know. And I think one of the greater voices that I’ve ever heard is Joe Williams. And he still remains that way.…
A couple of other things I’d like to ask you. If you had some words to the wise, to say to young jazz singers coming up, about the real essence of the music, what would you share?
